source_note: All ids verified live against PO.DAAC Hydrocron v1 /timeseries (default collection = Version D: SWOT_L2_HR_RiverSP_D with SWORD v17b; SWOT_L2_HR_LakeSP_D with PLD 202) on 2026-10-12/13 with one request per id, window start_time=2025-10-01T00:00:00Z end_time=2026-10-12T00:00:00Z, output=geojson. Reach fields requested: reach_id,time_str,river_name,wse,width,slope,dschg_c,reach_q,crid,collection_shortname,collection_version,sword_version,p_lat,p_lon. PriorLake fields: lake_id,time_str,lake_name,wse,area_total,quality_f,crid,collection_shortname,collection_version,PLD_version,p_lat,p_lon,p_ref_area. Reach ids were found by querying NASA Earthdata GIS's public SWOT_L2_HR_RiverSP_reach_vD_BASIC feature service by river_name (one 21-day cycle, Aug 1-22 2026, reach_q<=1, wse valid) and taking the type-1 (river) reach nearest a named city/landmark. PriorLake ids came from Lake-TopoCat v1.1 (Zenodo 14202301, built on PLD v106): largest lakes by Lake_area per Pfafstetter-2 basin, or nearest outlet to the target; each was confirmed by the lake_name and p_lat/p_lon Hydrocron returns. passes_12mo = Hydrocron rows (hits) in the window, including passes with no_data/fill; valid_obs_12mo = rows with a real time_str and non-fill wse. Fill value is -999999999999.0 (treated as null). Fields listed under 'fields' had at least one non-fill value. dschg_c was fill for every reach in Version D. Reach geometry = SWORD centerline LineString returned by Hydrocron, rounded to 4 dp, consecutive duplicate points removed, not decimated. PriorLake geometry: Hydrocron returns only a Point (the computed centroid of the observed water, which changes from pass to pass), never a polygon. The value stored here is the PLD prior centroid (p_lon,p_lat). Quality: use reach_q (rivers) or quality_f (lakes). Lake rows from partial-coverage passes can have very wrong area_total and biased wse. Example: Lake Mead in Sept 2026 had area_total from 53 to 409 km2 and wse from 354.8 to 371.5 m across passes.
